description.value: Purebread is a well-regarded BC artisan bakery chain with locations across Whistler, Vancouver, and Squamish, known for freshly baked breads, pastries, pies, and cakes. The Squamish location sits in Garibaldi Village and offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable stop for cyclists passing through. The bakery has received media coverage from outlets including the New York Times, Lonely Planet, and Vogue, underscoring its reputation as a destination-worthy stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Purebread Bakery location in Squamish (Garibaldi Village, 105-40147 Glenalder Place) with a phone number, indoor and outdoor seating (corroborated by OSM tags), and a full menu of freshly baked breads, pastries, and cakes. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. OSM records the name as 'Pure Bread' (two words) while the website consistently uses 'Purebread' as a single word — flagged as a name discrepancy.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Pure Bread' (two words) but the website consistently uses 'Purebread' as a single word across all pages and branding.
No phone or address in OSM; both sourced from the website's /find-us page for the Squamish location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible artisan bakery with confirmed Squamish location — a practical food and rest stop for touring cyclists on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.
